_comment: One row per module. 'needs' are ingest flags: a module whose needs are not met is skipped as 'not applicable'. 'python' lets a module run in its own virtualenv. Write your name in 'owner' so two people never edit the same module folder.

modules.name: g1_visual_match
modules.notes: image: FAISS + tiny32 thumbnail. video: FAISS on 1 frame/s; non-exact matching stays disabled until its threshold has a report

modules.name: aligner
modules.notes: image: ORB + RANSAC. video: robust frame-timeline fit + jump detection

modules.name: diff_picture
modules.notes: image: ECC-refined block difference + detail check. video: same metrics on 1-second aligned frames

modules.name: diff_transcript
modules.notes: video: local faster-whisper word timestamps + waveform comparison; ranges uncalibrated

modules.name: diff_sync
modules.notes: video: per-second paired mouth measurements and AV correlation; skipped when measurements fail
